features.gap_summary: Validated gaps or unknowns: Concurrent node claims and writes are unguarded; Example-node behavior is undefined; Operational ownership and consumers are unspecified; GUI wording lacks accessibility and localization bindings. Explicit non-gaps: Unknown node fields are explicitly rejected.
features.summary: Normalized local concept for node-execution-ordering. Validated observations: Concurrent node claims and writes are unguarded: Node status is represented as a scalar value with no concurrency or transition-authorship metadata. | Example-node behavior is undefined: The optional example boolean has no defined behavioral effect. | Declared deterministic execution ordering: The graph publishes fixed execution-ordering rule labels for readiness, selection, completion, and spec-lock sourcing. | Unknown node fields are explicitly rejected: Node objects are closed against unlisted properties. | Operational ownership and consumers are unspecified: Node shape names objectives and tools but contains no owner, caller, consumer, approver, support, or observability contract. | GUI wording lacks accessibility and localization bindings: The one GUI wording rule has no localization key, assistive semantics, freshness indicator, or broader misleading-state contract. | Status-to-verifier consistency guard: The allowed status states are enumerated and conditionally bound to verifier outcomes. | Node contract and artifact bindings: Every node requires contract_refs, inputs, and outputs, and each input or output entry requires kind and ref.
features.title: Node Execution Ordering

features.gap_summary: Validated gaps or unknowns: Approval can occur without executable acceptance content; NodeSeed review outcome fields can contradict each other.
features.summary: Normalized local concept for nodeseed-workgraph-worknode. Validated observations: Approval can occur without executable acceptance content: NodeSeed and WorkNode lifecycle statuses are not conditioned on non-empty executable inputs, acceptance criteria, or validators. | NodeSeed review outcome fields can contradict each other: node_seed_review does not bind review_status to decision or require required_changes for a changes-required outcome.
features.title: NodeSeed WorkGraph WorkNode

features.gap_summary: Validated gaps or unknowns: Acceptance command safety is outside the schema. Explicit non-gaps: Assigned schema source is structurally complete.
features.summary: Normalized local concept for plan-node-acceptance-execution. Validated observations: Execution and governance payload is concretely typed: The property contract supplies typed structures for objectives, ProjectContract references, executable acceptance checks, evidence, tool and workspace authority, change budgets, graph links, lifecycle status, verifier results, decisions, and spec-lock requirements. | Acceptance command safety is outside the schema: Acceptance commands are arbitrary non-empty strings with optional cwd and timeout, but the schema does not bind their execution semantics or require safe handling as untrusted input. | Assigned schema source is structurally complete: The schema closes after its reusable acceptance-check and command-spec definitions, and no trailing source content is omitted from the assigned window.
features.title: Plan Node Acceptance Execution

features.gap_summary: Validated gaps or unknowns: Dependency graph integrity requires an external oracle.
features.summary: Normalized local concept for plan-node-dependency-graph. Validated observations: Dependency graph integrity requires an external oracle: Dependency-like fields are non-empty unique string arrays, but this per-node schema provides no referential-integrity, acyclicity, reciprocal-edge, or consistency contract across nodes.
features.title: Plan Node Dependency Graph

features.gap_summary: Validated gaps or unknowns: Lifecycle ordering and race semantics are unspecified; Failed nodes lack mandatory recovery evidence.
features.summary: Normalized local concept for plan-node-lifecycle. Validated observations: Lifecycle ordering and race semantics are unspecified: The schema constrains each status snapshot but defines no legal prior-to-next transition graph, transition authority, compare-and-swap rule, or concurrency behavior. | Status is coupled to verifier outcome: Conditional branches enforce status-to-verifier-result consistency for terminal, failed, and active statuses, including timestamps for verified, done, and failed nodes. | Failed nodes lack mandatory recovery evidence: Failure snapshots require fail and timestamp through allOf, but verifier_result.message is optional and no structured recovery or rollback data is defined.
features.title: Plan Node Lifecycle

features.gap_summary: Validated gaps or unknowns: Requirement traceability is optional.

features.title: Plan Node Requirement Traceability

features.gap_summary: Explicit non-gaps: Closed root node contract.
features.summary: Normalized local concept for project-plan-node-schema. Validated observations: Closed root node contract: The schema identifies a closed root object and explicitly requires the core node, acceptance, evidence, tool-policy, change-budget, dependency, status, verification, decision, and spec-lock fields.
features.title: Project Plan Node Schema

features.gap_summary: Validated gaps or unknowns: Activation state list is not a state machine.
features.summary: Normalized local concept for worknode-and-executor-activation. Validated observations: Activation state list is not a state machine: The activation states array has a minimum of six enum-valued entries but no uniqueness, completeness, ordering, legal-transition, rollback, or concurrency relation. | WorkNode runtime requires attempt governance: The WorkNode runtime requires at least four record contracts plus cardinality and attempt rule lists. | Activation defines a six-state vocabulary: Executor activation declares six allowed state names from activation_pending through active or cancelled_before_mutation and requires records plus transaction rules.
features.title: WorkNode And Executor Activation

features.gap_summary: Validated gaps or unknowns: WorkNode invalid-transition rule has no state machine.
features.summary: Normalized local concept for worknode-runtime-state-machine. Validated observations: WorkNode invalid-transition rule has no state machine: WorkNode transition receipts carry from_state and to_state and promise to block invalid transitions, but the allowed WorkNode lifecycle states and transition graph are absent from this contract.
features.title: WorkNode Runtime State Machine

instructions.domain_rule: All provisional features must retain owner_domain=work_nodes_tasks_goals; cross-domain concepts become cross_domain_terms or relationships, never merges.
instructions.membership_rule: Every assigned local_feature_ref must have exactly one membership and appear in exactly one provisional_feature.local_feature_refs list.
instructions.merge_rule: Merge only when concepts are the same product feature under the same authority/lifecycle. Shared vocabulary or adjacency is not enough.
instructions.objective: Deduplicate true synonyms within this one owner domain while preserving distinct lifecycles, authorities, consumers, states, failures, gaps, and explicit non-gaps.
instructions.output_rule: Write exactly one strict-schema JSON payload in the assigned output directory, then return PMR1.
instructions.provenance_rule: Source documents and source-unit refs in each provisional feature must equal the union from its member local features.
instructions.research_lineage_rule: Research/scenario obligations remain in the immutable local-feature ledger and will be mechanically unioned after domain reduction; do not invent external evidence here.
instructions.split_rule: Keep distinct features when authority, lifecycle, consumer, state machine, failure/recovery, security boundary, or user-visible promise differs.
